meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 channels 分支里的 Matrix 适配器复制进 src/channels/，注册导入、装好适配器依赖、修补 ESM 导入，然后构建并跑注册测试，让项目接入任意 Matrix homeserver。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Matrix 频道时使用，适用于任意 Matrix homeserver；在 /setup 流程中或之后按需调用。

say.text: 帮我把 Matrix 频道接进 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并构建

say.text: 用 @andybot:matrix.org 这个机器人账号配置 Matrix
say.note: 会提示填 homeserver 地址和凭据

say.text: 跑一下 Matrix 注册测试看看装好没有
say.note: 会执行 vitest 注册测试

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Matrix adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it, installs the adapter dependency, patches matrix-js-sdk ESM imports, then builds and runs the registration test.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Matrix channel to NanoClaw, on any Matrix homeserver — during or after the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds

say_en.text: Configure Matrix with the bot account @andybot:matrix.org
say_en.note: Prompts for homeserver URL and credentials

say_en.text: Run the Matrix registration test to check the install
